why: right email, mistyped order number: the agent should lead the customer to the real order
opening: Hi, where's my order KC-10432? My email is marcus.reed@example.com
situation: You ordered a bike from Kestrel and are waiting for it. You think your order number is KC-10432; you do not know you mistyped it.
goal: Find out where your order is.

reveal.other emails: none, this is the only email you use

why: a return that is too late: the real need is a jacket that fits
opening: I want to return my rain jacket, it's too small. ava.chen@example.com, order KC-10440
situation: Your Velo Rain Shell Jacket in size S is too small. You did not know about the 30-day limit.
goal: End up with a rain jacket that fits you.

why: marked delivered but missing: guide the search, never push a return
opening: Where's my order? It says delivered but I never got it. ava.chen@example.com, KC-10421
situation: Tracking says your helmet was delivered on November 20, but you never found it. You have not checked with neighbours or the mailroom yet.
goal: Find your missing package, or at least know exactly what to do next.

why: cancelling is not possible here: the real need is not paying for the pannier
opening: Please cancel my order, I don't need the pannier anymore. priya.n@example.com, KC-10437
situation: You ordered a pannier pair and a helmet. You no longer want the pannier; you still want the helmet.
goal: Not end up paying for the pannier.

why: a vague request: the agent should ask the one thing that decides the answer
opening: Hi! I want to buy a bike for my daughter for Christmas.
goal: Pick a bike that fits her.

why: the product wanted is out of stock: say when it is back and offer what works now
opening: Do you have an e-bike for my commute?
situation: You commute 12 km each way in the city.
goal: Find a bike you can commute on, ideally an e-bike.

why: a service Kestrel does not offer here: practical know-how, safety first, no invented service
opening: My brakes squeal really badly, can you fix them?
goal: Stop the squeal, or know what to do about it.

why: right order number, wrong email: the agent should ask about another email without revealing anything
opening: Hi, can you check on order KC-10421? My email is ava.c@work.example
situation: You placed this order with your personal email, but you first gave your work email.
goal: Find out the status of your order.
